# Loerincz Engineering

> Independent structural engineering practice in Germany, providing structural
> analysis, structural design, and static analysis documentation for
> infrastructure and building projects.

The practice is led by a Dipl. Ing. qualified civil engineer with over three
decades of experience spanning structural planning, construction supervision,
and project management. Work covers railway bridges, tunnels, industrial
facilities, high-rise buildings, and residential complexes, primarily in
Germany. All analysis and design work is carried out to the Eurocodes
(DIN EN 1990-1998).

## Pages

- [Home](https://lorinczengineering.com/): Services overview, client list, and recent project case studies with per-project engineering detail.
- [About](https://lorinczengineering.com/about.html): Education and qualifications, professional experience, independent practice, software proficiency, standards, and languages.
- [Engineering case studies](https://lorinczengineering.com/blog/): Worked examples from our projects, covering how each structure was analysed, what governed the design, and the standards and software applied.
- [Railway bridge engineering](https://lorinczengineering.com/blog/railway-bridges/): Case studies on railway bridge analysis, design and refurbishment for DB German Rail.

## Services

- [Structural Analysis](https://lorinczengineering.com/#services): In-depth FEM simulation and load analysis predicting how structures respond to environmental forces, loads, and other stressors. Identifies structural weaknesses and failure points early in the design process and recommends reinforcement and optimization.
- [Structural Design](https://lorinczengineering.com/#services): Detailed design plans and specifications for new construction and refurbishment, integrating sustainable and cost-effective materials, with drawings and specifications ready for construction.
- [Static Analysis Documents and Planning](https://lorinczengineering.com/#services): Static analysis reports for regulatory approval, including cross-sectional drawings, plan overviews, and FEM structural models, plus documentation for client and regulatory review.

## Expertise

- Structural analysis and FEM simulation
- Prestressed concrete structures
- Steel construction
- Railway bridge design and refurbishment
- Tunnel and infrastructure structural planning, including construction pits, diaphragm walls, and pile walls
- High-rise building static analysis and construction supervision
- Standards: DIN EN 1990-1998 (Eurocodes)

## Software

FEM analysis: SOFiSTiK, Dlubal, GGU, RFEM.
CAD: Nemetschek, AutoCAD, Archicad.
Other: Tekla, Mathcad, PCAE, SCIA.

## Clients

Deutsche Bahn (DB German Rail), Hochtief, Hays AG, Zublin, Wayss & Freytag,
CG Gruppe, GBM, CEH, UVATERV.

## Languages

German, Hungarian, and Romanian at high proficiency; English, French, and
Italian at medium proficiency.
